title: Screen Rotation issue
body:
In Xdrip (versions 06/04/21, 13/04/21 & 24/04/21) on android 10 (Xiaomi Mi A2 - android one)
When rotating the screen to landscape, then returning to portrait, Xdrip does not reconfigure to portrait correctly.
Have been able to reproduce this on a friends Pixel 3 - also on android 10
